local_review.finding_body: The contribution changed the 2.3.21 baseline outside the single-version file set and configured the 2.4.0 native test binary to run JvmDependencyTest.main instead of the JUnit launcher. That made the native lane execute only a trivial classpath assertion while the Kotlin tests and their metadata remained unverified, violating the closed-file-set and Native Image execution requirements. Removing the override reproduced the concealed evidence: the full native suite found 14 tests and initially failed on missing Kotlin serialization metadata and PathUtil assertions that assumed filesystem-backed class resources. The generated suite also combined the KJvmCompiledScriptKt and KJvmCompiledScript dynamic-access targets in one file and retained test-only/no-op resource metadata.
local_review.finding_title: Native test main-class override bypasses the JUnit suite
local_review.fix_note: Restored the complete 2.3.21 tree, removed the native main-class override, restored the required AssertJ test dependency, repaired the Kotlin serialization metadata from the supported baseline behavior, and made PathUtil exercise a library class resource rather than a test class. Split KJvmCompiledScriptKt into its dedicated test file, removed test-only/no-op resource entries, and regenerated stable library statistics. All three native lanes and finalization checks now pass with no further publishable change.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the contribution scope, native-image repair, test-contract musts, metadata format, index evidence, and old/new statistics. After repair, the diff is limited to org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-scripting-jvm:2.4.0 and its artifact index/statistics. Dynamic-access coverage is preserved at 39/39 overall, including reflection 31/31 and resources 8/8. The Forge finalizer completed current-defaults, future-defaults-all, and GraalVM 25 native lanes plus metadata, style, generated-test-validity, and statistics checks, then completed a second time without changing the publishable tree. The repaired contribution is approved.
